note: Macro fixes: a same-method #[cfg(test)] / #[cfg(not(test))] route twin returning a return-type alias is told apart by its alias-expanded signature (fn_definitions stores the same form as the route storage); a `use crate::*;` glob inherits the crate root's cron imports (and foreign-cron state), not the enclosing module's; an empty security scheme name is rejected at compile time.
